remarks: Welcome to 193 Eden Road in Stamford, a spacious 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home filled with opportunity and potential! This wonderful property offers generous living space, including an additional room on the lower level that can easily be used as a fifth bedroom, home office, gym, or flex space to fit your needs. Featuring two beautiful fireplaces, this home provides warmth, charm, and the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. A desirable layout, and endless possibilities to customize and add your personal touch, this is the perfect opportunity to create your dream home. Located in a sought-after Stamford neighborhood, this property offers space, character, and tremendous value. Don't miss the chance to make this amazing property your own!
